name: How long does it take to see results from AEO content optimization?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO content optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe to see results from AEO content optimization can vary depending on several factors, including the competitiveness of your industry, the authority of your website, and the specific queries you are targeting. While some businesses might see initial improvements in featured snippet visibility within a few weeks, more significant and consistent gains typically take 3 to 6 months. AEO is an ongoing process that requires continuous monitoring, refinement, and adaptation to maintain visibility as search algorithms and user behaviors evolve.
acceptedAnswer.description: Results can vary, with initial improvements potentially seen in weeks. More significant and consistent gains typically take 3 to 6 months, as AEO is an ongoing process.
